# Payment Scheduled Maintenance. Wednesday, June 18th, 2025

_Category: Uncategorized · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**neeraja.kumar** (6/17/2025):

Please be advised there is a planned maintenance for our payment systems planned for Wednesday, June 18th, 2025, From 6:00 am until 7:00 am. 
Clients will be unable to complete any form of transactions at this time on the Modern Registries Platform.
This includes PAD, Online Banking, Credit Card, EFT, and BCOL forms of payments.

We are sorry for the inconvenience.
